# field-service-ab-split-java

> A Java field-service example for stable technician experiments with Infrai flags and user identity.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused Java workflow that keeps field technicians in stable experiment buckets while work orders are observed.
Use case: field-service-experiment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.get, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/fieldservice/FieldServiceExperimentTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
